projects.name: private triage agent
projects.abstract: An open source privacy preserving email triage agent. A local model (gemma3:27b) handles every email; and when harder reasoning is needed, sensitive information is stripped through regex → transformer NER → neural coreference, sent to Claude as placeholders, and re-hydrated locally.
